LESSON.HEADINGS: <1>A pangram uses every letter of the alphabet. Try one:</1> <2>Good! Here are some more pangrams.</2> <3>Last set. Watch for the rare letters!</3>
LESSON.DESCRIPTION: Pangrams are sentences that use every letter of the alphabet at least once, so they are great practice for every finger.

TASK.TEXT: The quick brown fox jumps over a lazy dog.
Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.
Jackdaws love my big sphinx of quartz.
Big fjords vex quick waltz nymph.
Five jumbo squid gawk at hazy pixel crab.
Lazy walrus fixed my quick jet-black buoy.
Jovial divers quickly grab six frozen kelp.
Quiet gray sharks jump over five dozen wax
blocks. Zippy jellyfish quiz the brave ox.
Wild kelp, frozen jam, quick vaults of gray
bricks: each a puzzle to explore by night.
